title: Remove a Visible Seedance Watermark from an Image
description: Process a Seedance image or extracted video frame you own or may edit. Current preview processing returns an unchanged copy.
heading: Clean visible Seedance marks from authorized images
intro: Use the private image workflow for a Seedance still or extracted frame. Direct video processing and invisible provenance removal are outside the current MVP.

faq.question: Can I upload a Seedance video?
faq.answer: No. The current tool accepts one JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 10 MB. Export a frame first if you need to test the workflow.

faq.question: Does it remove the mark today?
faq.answer: Not yet. The preview provider currently returns an unchanged copy while production processing is integrated.

faq.question: Are files private?
faq.answer: Files use private object storage and are scheduled for deletion after 24 hours.

faq.question: What may I process?
faq.answer: Only process media you own or have permission to modify.
